name: Gradient-based Occlusion Information Computation
definition: A method to compute occlusion information $m_x$ for a voxel $x$ that preserves boundaries by modulating a spherical neighborhood mean with a gradient-based weight $g_x$, avoiding the isotropic blurring of simple ambient occlusion.
summary: Gradient-based Occlusion Information Computation computes a view-independent occlusion metric that preserves sharp boundaries by modulating neighborhood means with gradient weights, avoiding the isotropic blurring of simple spherical mean ambient occlusion.
